speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Now the plot. I have fed you. You may pay me in the story. Four things, and I will tell you if they are a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A fire. A walk. A barn. A back. That is the order, and I am not decorating it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A fire is a beginning. Whose?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The town's, at the north end, before I went. I did not go for the fire. I went because she sent, and the sending was harvest as much as fire. The walk was the road home to her, and then the road back here.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Four days, sir? Mistress counted the loaves while you were gone, and she would not let me count them aloud.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Four days on a road is a middle. The barn is the turn, if a barn can turn. Did it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A cousin's barn. I was too proud to be the man who only handed the timber. The back is what the pride cost. It has walked home with me. It is not eased.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And is the man in it the wiser?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He has seen a house he means to buy.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: With what?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the fourth act, Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then I will not have the fourth act at my table. A play that will not say where the money is has left the money in the tiring-house. Mark me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not saying the sum because I do not know it. Not because I am saving it for a gallery.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf wants the notch, sir. I was told not to call it a small loaf where you could make it a speech.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf wants a full thumb of the notch. It wanted it before you went. It wants it now. Eat it. Do not price it, and do not console it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A thumb short. I see it. I am not pricing a penny loaf, and I am not mending a harvest with a sentence.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The looms are quiet. Nobody has shouted at me since Lammas. I tell you the quiet, because a quiet house is the plot I can speak for.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then that is the part of the house I am glad to hear. The looms quiet, and no one shouting.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He pays his way and he keeps his hours. You will do the same with the candle. I have had the fire, the walk, the barn and the back. I have not had a wise man. I have had a man who has seen a house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the honest end of the plot. The wise man is not in this act.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And the girl with the moon is not in this act either, sir. I am only saying I remember there was one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She is not today's plot. Today's plot is a back that came home, and a house with no sum under it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A house with no sum is a house still in the head. The shuttle goes and comes. Work is kinder than a sum you do not have.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Kinder, and not an answer. Master Shakespeare, the fourth act can stay the fourth act. The loaf will not wait on it. Pass it down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Down. And I thank you for taking the story in four words and not in forty. I have walked beside a man who would have made it forty miles of telling.
